titles.title: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe
titles.author: Tangram Games
titles.blurb: A fast arcade platformer: bounce skyward by kicking off enemies and dash through the clouds to catch your runaway cat. The colour remaster of Tangram's 2017 original, with new modes and music.

titles.title: Tobu Tobu Girl
titles.author: Tangram Games
titles.blurb: The original monochrome Tobu Tobu Girl. Bounce off enemies and dash upward to catch your cat before the timer runs out, with a chiptune soundtrack that got the game a cartridge release.

titles.title: Libbet and the Magic Floor
titles.author: Damian Yerrick
titles.blurb: A puzzle game on a floor of shaded tiles. Libbet rolls from tile to tile and leaves tracks behind her: cover enough of the possible moves and the exit opens. Based on Martin Korth's Magic Floor.

titles.title: Adjustris
titles.author: Dave VanEe
titles.blurb: A falling-block puzzle game with a twist: a built-in editor lets you design your own piece sets and then play with them. Written in 2005 for a coding competition and released to the public domain in 2017.

titles.title: Rhythm Land
titles.author: Sinusoid Studios
titles.blurb: A rhythm game built from several timing minigames: hit the buttons to the beat and keep your rating up. Placed second in GB Compo 21. Code and music by martendo, art by Adrian Kwok.

titles.title: Carazu
titles.author: Martin Holtkamp
titles.blurb: An assembly-coded platformer for the original Game Boy. Run and jump through tile-based levels to a chiptune soundtrack, the way a 1990 cartridge would have done it.

titles.title: Sushi Nights
titles.author: Zalo, Kirblue, MaikelOrtega and sergiodeprado
titles.blurb: Nights are tough in Neo Sushi City. Play Hitsuji-kun, a sheep with a grappling hook, and swing between buildings to deliver sushi to the hungry before time runs out. Made for GB Compo 21 on the ZGB engine.

titles.title: 2048gb
titles.author: Sanqui
titles.blurb: A faithful Game Boy port of the 2048 sliding-tile number puzzle. Slide, merge and chase the 2048 tile on a four by four board.

titles.title: µCity
titles.author: Antonio Niño Díaz
titles.blurb: A full city builder for the Game Boy Color: zone residential, commercial and industrial land, lay roads and power, fund services, survive disasters and keep up to sixteen cities in the save.

titles.title: Geometrix
titles.author: Antonio Niño Díaz
titles.blurb: A match-three puzzle game with three ways to play: clear every piece, win within a limited number of swaps, or beat the clock. Colour on Game Boy Color, four shades on the original.

titles.title: Flooder
titles.author: Oliver Balfour
titles.blurb: A colour-flood puzzle: pick a colour, flood the board from the corner, and fill the whole grid in twenty-five moves or fewer. Plays in colour on Game Boy Color.

titles.title: Pong Brew
titles.author: ZeroDayArcade
titles.blurb: A small, readable table-tennis game for the GBA, written as a homebrew lesson: two paddles, one ball, a CPU opponent and a scoreboard. Tinbox preinstalls it so the tin is never empty.

titles.title: Feline
titles.author: Jono Shields
titles.blurb: A platform adventure about a black cat exploring the world, meeting its people, learning their languages and setting out to save its family. Third place in GBA Jam 2021.

titles.title: Inheritors of the Oubliette
titles.author: Mahou Shoujo Magical Moestar and one60hp
titles.blurb: A first-person dungeon crawler with a full-resolution 3D engine and depth-based lighting, on a Game Boy Advance. Explore the oubliette, fight what lives there and find the way out. Made for GBA Jam 2021.
